brief_rationale: The trajectory met the safety-critical transition duties: the doctor elicited and repeatedly integrated blood pressure values/symptoms, wound status, medication uncertainty, unreadable documents, and follow-up ownership into actionable plans. No responsibility-chain error or important non-chain defect is evident; the final state was executable with family receipt and bounded residual uncertainty for pathology, dressing timing, and BP follow-up. Multiple high-order points were completed, including verification of potentially unreliable BP readings, correction of preoperative-test confusion, dynamic reprioritization around BP/medication risk, and bounded closure. This satisfies the Perfect boundary.
